741200604.text: This process was the capture of fugitive elements from the Narzissenkreuz Ordo. Ms. Mary-Ann was also executing this process.

741200605.text: As her companion and guard, I followed her and *garbled mechanical noises* into Elynas.

741200609.text: Well, guess there really was some relation there, then... Gah! We should've captured Jakob and questioned him.

741200610.text: Paimon wonders if he'll come back here — if we ever meet again, we're gonna have questions for him.

741200612.text: If all else fails, we can just... y'know, go good-cop bad-cop on him! There's gotta be some way, or else we're stuck waiting for Seymour to recall stuff.

741200613.text: You mean, when I complete my record space collation, Ms. Paimon.

741200614.text: Those things are basically the same!

741200701.text: Tell me about your latest records...

741200702.text: A fierce battle against the members of the Ordo broke out within Elynas. My storage unit encountered an error due to massive trauma.

741200703.text: We must foil the Ordo's plans. To that end, Jakob Ingold, *garbled mechanical noises* ... *garbled mechanical noises* must be stopped.

741200704.text: Due to *garbled mechanical noises* ... *garbled mechanical noises* ... *garbled mechanical noises* ... to Ms. Mary-Ann.

741200707.text: Seems like we're gonna have to wait for you to do that collation thing, Seymour...

741200709.text: Affirmative. Your summary is overly simplistic, perhaps, but it is basically the truth, Ms. Paimon.

741200801.text: If we only have this information...

741200802.text: Finding Mary-Ann might be somewhat difficult.
